import urllib.request
import json
from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis

def check_protein(acc):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    
    seq_data = data.get('sequence', {})
    seq = seq_data.get('value', '')
    mol_weight_api = seq_data.get('molWeight')
    calc_mw = ProteinAnalysis(seq).molecular_weight() if seq else None
    
    print(f"Accession: {acc}")
    print(f"Length: {len(seq)}")
    print(f"API molWeight: {mol_weight_api}")
    print(f"Calculated MW: {calc_mw:.2f} Da ({calc_mw/1000:.2f} kDa)")
    return data
